name: high_error_rate

query_condition.sql: SELECT k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name, count(*) as cnt FROM "default" WHERE body LIKE '%error%' GROUP BY k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name HAVING cnt > 15
